refnamediv.refpurpose: This function computes peak full width at half minimum or at another level of peak minimum for vector or matrix data y supplied as input.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: f = fwhmjlt(y) f = fwhmjlt(x, y) f = fwhmjlt(…, "zero") f = fwhmjlt(…, "min") f = fwhmjlt(…, "alevel", level) f = fwhmjlt(…, "rlevel", level)

listitem.para: vector or matrix. If y is a matrix, fwhm is calculated for each column as a row vector.
The second argument is by default "zero" which computes the fwhm at half maximum.
If it is "min", fwhm is computed at middle curve.
The option "rlevel" computes full-width at the given relative level of peak profile.
The option "alevel" computes full-width at the given absolute level of y.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function computes peak full width at half minimum or at another level of peak minimum for vector or matrix data y supplied as input. This function returns 0 if FWHM does not exist.
